# Test Videos

This directory contains test videos for CitySeg tests.

- `test_video.mp4`: A short test video with a moving circle
- `test_frames.mp4`: A very short test video with frame numbers

Videos are deliberately small (320x240) and short (10-30 frames) to ensure tests run quickly.

You can recreate these videos by running the `create_test_video.py` script in this directory.
